candidate.user_submission: Di pikin dey 18 months. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. E dey drink water as e suppose. E dey restless or e dey vex. E eye don sink. If I pinch e skin, e skin return back normal. E no get blood for stool. E no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey weak or dey like person wey don faint. E sabi drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. E no get cough or dey breathe hard. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever.

fact_evidence.evidence_text: E dey drink water as e suppose.
